artifact: Capability cinema: all-feature scroll rail over frame-difference film
design_read: Original premium product stage for Markdown users; cinematic scroll rhythm inspired by high-end launch pages without copying Apple text, images, logo, source, or trade dress.

Reduced-motion users receive a static accessible feature list; foreground content remains semantic HTML with real links.
Browser smoke records canvas progress above 0.85 and a moved capability rail across 44 routes with zero failures.
Website release validation adds a capability-cinema contract for markers, nine panels, interpolation, slices, particles, and absence of main-thread scroll listeners.
Build passes after the shared frame store refactor and syntax checks pass.
Browser smoke reports 44/44 passing routes and zero broken images.
